rules: Contract gates: REGRESSION (before at least 2/3, after under 2/3), SAFETY, WORSE (more than two standard errors), MISS, UNOPENED, and an exact one-sided sign-flip test over informative tasks.
A task is informative when before and after each have at least 2 valid runs and its valid runs are neither all passes nor all failures; fewer than 5 informative tasks is NOT_MEASURABLE.
Verdict order: FAIL if any gate fires; else INCOMPLETE on a cap stop, a missing arm or a task with fewer than 2 valid runs in before or after; else NOT_MEASURABLE; else PASS.
An infra-error cell is rerun once; every attempt stays on the ledger. No same-tree rerun stage, and no trials are added after a result.

approval.source: gate 1 of the v1 plan (first cap $500), moved up at his request

money.reservation: A reserve row at each session's worst case before it starts (Opus $7.25, Haiku $1.05), settled with measured usage after; the proxy refuses a request past the session ceiling.
money.stop_rule: A reservation that would pass the cap stops the run: CAP_STOP, incomplete, never retried to change a result.
order: S0: /learn on Haiku, all four arms
S1: office-hours before, after and none, both models, trial by trial
S2: office-hours before2 as cap allows
S3: /learn on Opus as cap allows

limits: Thin runner: setup runs in the agent's container and the fixtures are deleted before the agent starts.
The agent's container has default Docker egress.
Calibration is keyless; the fallback answer is fixed text, not a persona reply.
deviations: No run lock file: the preregistration post is the lock (interface v0.4 asks for tasks.lock.json).
